allowedAnchors.label: manipulation versus inspiration
allowedAnchors.text: Price cuts, fear, novelty, peer pressure, and promotions can trigger behavior without creating durable loyalty. A reader learns why a spike in sales or attention is not the same as belief-driven preference.
